scripts.build: npm run verify:production-env && npm run build:bundle
scripts.test:critical: npm run test:critical:reading && npm run test:critical:reporting && npm run test:critical:sync && npm run test:critical:series
scripts.verify:source-of-truth: npm run verify:source-boundary && npm run verify:domain-taxonomy
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:android && npx cap sync android && npm run android:branding:sync && npm run verify:android-config && npm run verify:android-gradle && npm run verify:android-branding
scripts.firebase:deploy:functions: npm run functions:build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only functions --project inkbound-app
scripts.firebase:deploy:security: npm run functions:build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only firestore:rules,storage,functions --project inkbound-app
scripts.firebase:deploy:web: npm run verify:web-release && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting --project inkbound-app
scripts.firebase:deploy:all: npm run release:verify && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules,storage,functions --project inkbound-app
scripts.verify:web-release: npm run lint && npm run test:critical && npm run verify:source-of-truth && npm run verify:parity && npm run build && npm run verify:release-artifacts
scripts.firebase:deploy:admin-repair: npm run verify:web-release && npm run functions:build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting,functions:correctAdminUserEmail,functions:mergeAdminUserAccounts --project inkbound-app
scripts.firebase:deploy:admin-support: npm run verify:web-release && npm run functions:build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting,functions:getAdminDashboard,functions:syncUserDirectory,functions:correctAdminUserEmail,functions:mergeAdminUserAccounts,functions:resendAdminVerificationEmail,functions:sendAdminPasswordResetEmail,functions:addAdminSupportNote --project inkbound-app
